dialogues.jp: わいわい、がやがや、と廊下に活気がみなぎる。
dialogues.en: The corridor bustles with activity.
dialogues.text: The corridor bustles with activity.

dialogues.jp: 「……みんな元気やなぁ」
dialogues.en: "How can they be so energetic?"
dialogues.text: "How can they be so energetic?"

dialogues.jp:
なんだか、ひとりだけ力なく歩く自分がひどく
浮いているというかなんというか。
dialogues.en: I feel I'm the only one standing out as a walking limp.
dialogues.text: I feel I'm the only one standing out as a walking limp.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……はぁはぁ」
dialogues.en: "Huff, puff..."
dialogues.text: "Huff, puff..."

dialogues.jp: 目の前を金色の髪が走り抜けていく。
dialogues.en: A blonde head passes in front of me.
dialogues.text: A blonde head passes in front of me.

dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
さくらだけど……声をかける前に人の波に消え
てしまった。
dialogues.en:
It was Sakura, but she disappeared into the crowd before I
could call out to her.
dialogues.text:
It was Sakura, but she disappeared into the crowd before I
could call out to her.

dialogues.jp: なにか重たそうなモノを持っていたような。
dialogues.en: I think she was carrying something heavy.
dialogues.text: I think she was carrying something heavy.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、戻ってきた」
dialogues.en: "Oh, here she comes."
dialogues.text: "Oh, here she comes."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はぁはぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Huff, puff..."
dialogues.text: "Huff, puff..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さくら！」
dialogues.en: "Sakura!"
dialogues.text: "Sakura!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにょ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: とっと、と後ろ向きに足踏み。
dialogues.en: She takes a few steps backward.
dialogues.text: She takes a few steps backward.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「どしたのお兄ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing here, oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing here, oniichan?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「いや廊下を走ると危ないぞ……で、お前はいっ
　たいなにをやってるんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Watch out when you run in the hallway. Anyway, what are you
doing here?"
dialogues.text:
"Watch out when you run in the hallway. Anyway, what are you
doing here?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃ、先生のお手伝いで、教材を倉庫に戻
　してるんだよ♪」
dialogues.en:
"Umm, I've been helping my teacher get the teaching
materials back to the storage."
dialogues.text:
"Umm, I've been helping my teacher get the teaching
materials back to the storage."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「教材？」
dialogues.en: "Teaching materials?"
dialogues.text: "Teaching materials?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと特別な授業だったから、クラスのみ
　んなに古語辞典を配ったんだよ。でも、箱の
　底が抜けちゃったから手作業」
dialogues.en:
"We had a special curriculum for the class so we handed out
a dictionary of old words. But the dictionaries' box broke,
and now I have to carry them a few at a time."
dialogues.text:
"We had a special curriculum for the class so we handed out
a dictionary of old words. But the dictionaries' box broke,
and now I have to carry them a few at a time."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……面倒だな」
dialogues.en: "That's a bummer."
dialogues.text: "That's a bummer."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「でも、誰かがやらなくちゃ」
dialogues.en: "But somebody has to do it."
dialogues.text: "But somebody has to do it."

dialogues.jp:
まったく真っ白な笑みを浮かべて、さくらが額
の汗をぬぐう。
dialogues.en: Sakura wipes sweat off her forehead, smiling brightly.
dialogues.text: Sakura wipes sweat off her forehead, smiling brightly.

dialogues.jp: 「……誰も手伝ってないのかよ？」
dialogues.en: "Is anybody helping you?"
dialogues.text: "Is anybody helping you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃ、いいんだよ今週ボク週番さんだから。
　それに、みんなの目につかないところに置い
　たから」
dialogues.en:
"Mmm, nope. But it's okay, because I'm the one on the rota.
And besides, I put them back where nobody can find them."
dialogues.text:
"Mmm, nope. But it's okay, because I'm the one on the rota.
And besides, I put them back where nobody can find them."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ゆっくりとご飯食べたいでしょみんな♪」
dialogues.en: "You want to be relaxed when you eat lunch, don't you?"
dialogues.text: "You want to be relaxed when you eat lunch, don't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.jp: 額の髪をかきあげて、そのまま頭をかく。
dialogues.en: I fix the hair on my forehead and then scratch my head.
dialogues.text: I fix the hair on my forehead and then scratch my head.

dialogues.jp:
「あのなぁ、５人か１０人とかでいっぺんに運
　べば時間もかからないだろうが」
dialogues.en:
"You know what? Five or ten people could finish this before
you knew it."
dialogues.text:
"You know what? Five or ten people could finish this before
you knew it."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにょ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お前のクラスにはことりがいるだろう。こう
　いうときに気を利かせてくれそうなもんだけ
　どな」
dialogues.en:
"Kotori's in your class, isn't she? I think she wouldn't
mind helping you."
dialogues.text:
"Kotori's in your class, isn't she? I think she wouldn't
mind helping you."

dialogues.jp:
悪い意味ではなく、ことりならそういうことに
は率先して手を貸すはずなのだが。
dialogues.en:
I mean, Kotori would usually be the first one to lend a hand
in situations like this.
dialogues.text:
I mean, Kotori would usually be the first one to lend a hand
in situations like this.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ、ことりちゃん、ちょっと調子悪そうだ
　からいいんだよ！　言っちゃダメだよ！しー、
　だよ！」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, Kotori-chan, don't worry about it because you don't
look good! Don't say anything to anybody! It's a secret!"
dialogues.text:
"Hey, Kotori-chan, don't worry about it because you don't
look good! Don't say anything to anybody! It's a secret!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あっ、お前それでか！？　誰かに頼むと、ま
　ずことりが来ちゃうからだな？」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, I see! If you ask somebody, Kotori will be the first
one to come. Is that right?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh, I see! If you ask somebody, Kotori will be the first
one to come. Is that right?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃにゃ！」
dialogues.en: "Uh-huh!"
dialogues.text: "Uh-huh!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……まったく」
dialogues.en: "What the heck?"
dialogues.text: "What the heck?"

dialogues.jp:
そういうところで頑張って、自分の昼休みを潰
してどうするんだよコイツは。
dialogues.en:
She gets herself into situations like this, and eventually
she loses her lunch recess.
dialogues.text:
She gets herself into situations like this, and eventually
she loses her lunch recess.

dialogues.jp: どうせ義理人情とか言うんだろうが……。
dialogues.en: I know she would say it's love and duty.
dialogues.text: I know she would say it's love and duty.

dialogues.jp: 「バカ」
dialogues.en: "You idiot!"
dialogues.text: "You idiot!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ！？　ボク、バカじゃないもん！」
dialogues.en: "Hm? I'm not an idiot!"
dialogues.text: "Hm? I'm not an idiot!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「大バカか」
dialogues.en: "Then, you're a huge idiot!"
dialogues.text: "Then, you're a huge idiot!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「バカに大きいも小さいもないやい！」
dialogues.en: "There is no huge or tiny in idiocy!"
dialogues.text: "There is no huge or tiny in idiocy!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「手伝ってやるから、ひっそりと持ってこいよ」
dialogues.en: "I'll help you, so bring them quietly."
dialogues.text: "I'll help you, so bring them quietly."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ひっそりと！　……うにゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Quietly! ...Hmm?"
dialogues.text: "Quietly! ...Hmm?"

dialogues.jp: こちこち、と首をかしげて。
dialogues.en: She tilts her head a few times.
dialogues.text: She tilts her head a few times.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「手伝う？　いらないよ」
dialogues.en: "You'll help me? No thanks."
dialogues.text: "You'll help me? No thanks."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「バカ。これでお前放っぽってったら、飯がま
　ずくなるだろうが……自分のためだ」
dialogues.en:
"You idiot! If I leave you alone, the food is going to be
shit... It's for my sake."
dialogues.text:
"You idiot! If I leave you alone, the food is going to be
shit... It's for my sake."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それ、全然自分のためじゃない気が……」
dialogues.en: "It doesn't sound like it's for your sake at all."
dialogues.text: "It doesn't sound like it's for your sake at all."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あきらかに俺のためだろうが」
dialogues.en: "It is obviously for me, for God's sake."
dialogues.text: "It is obviously for me, for God's sake."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Love~"
dialogues.text: "Love~"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うわ、ひっつくな！！」
dialogues.en: "Wow, get off me!!"
dialogues.text: "Wow, get off me!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「やさしい……ぽ」
dialogues.en: "So nice..."
dialogues.text: "So nice..."

dialogues.jp: 腰にはりついたまま、さくらが頬を赤らめる。
dialogues.en: Sakura blushes as she clings on to my waist.
dialogues.text: Sakura blushes as she clings on to my waist.

dialogues.jp:
「ほら、せっかく飯を食う時間を作れるんだか
　ら、早くしろよ！」
dialogues.en: "C'mon, hurry up so we can get some lunch."
dialogues.text: "C'mon, hurry up so we can get some lunch."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「Ｙｅｓ，ｓｉｒ」
dialogues.en: "Yes, sir."
dialogues.text: "Yes, sir."

dialogues.jp:
てってこ、と隣を歩きながら、さくらはだらし
ない顔をさらに柔らかくする。
dialogues.en: Hurrying along next to me, Sakura looks very relieved.
dialogues.text: Hurrying along next to me, Sakura looks very relieved.

dialogues.jp: そして、ピンと人指し指を立てて、
dialogues.en: Then, pointing her index finger up,
dialogues.text: Then, pointing her index finger up,

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「今度、恩を仇で返さなきゃ♪」
dialogues.en: "Next time, I'll repay good with evil."
dialogues.text: "Next time, I'll repay good with evil."

dialogues.jp:
まったく役にたっていないと思われる古語辞典
を片付けなくてはならないと思うと、今更なが
らにため息をつく俺だった。
dialogues.en:
I sigh again, as I think that I have to put away the
dictionaries of old words, which didn't seem to help her at
all.
dialogues.text:
I sigh again, as I think that I have to put away the
dictionaries of old words, which didn't seem to help her at
all.

dialogues.jp: ◆健気な少女◆
dialogues.en: ◆Strong-minded girl◆
dialogues.text: ◆Strong-minded girl◆

dialogues.jp:
廊下で重そうな荷物を運ぶさくらを見かける。
なんでも、前の授業で使った教材の辞書を運ん
でいるらしい。
dialogues.en:
I saw Sakura carrying heavy stuff in the hallway. She said
she had to put away the teaching materials that they used at
the class.
dialogues.text:
I saw Sakura carrying heavy stuff in the hallway. She said
she had to put away the teaching materials that they used at
the class.

dialogues.jp: 面倒だったが、仕方なく手伝ってやる俺だった。
dialogues.en:
It was a pain in the neck for me, but I reluctantly decided
to help her.
dialogues.text:
It was a pain in the neck for me, but I reluctantly decided
to help her.
